meta.name: game-concept
meta.description: Design game concepts from a novel. From SOURCE_BIBLE and PRODUCT_BRIEF, generate three genuinely different directions on the dimensions still unlocked, then pick the most worthwhile playable prototype using hard vetoes and explicit trade-offs. Use for what game should this novel become, compare game concepts, choose a game direction for this book. 小说游戏概念设计。根据 SOURCE_BIBLE 与 PRODUCT_BRIEF 在未锁定维度上生成三个真正不同的方案，用硬否决和关键取舍选择最值得做的可玩原型。用于判断小说适合做成什么游戏、比较游戏方案等需求。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成三种游戏方案并挑出最值得做的可玩原型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你有小说版权,想理性选定改编成哪种游戏
copy.tagline_en: Generate three game concepts and pick the most worthwhile playable prototype
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own a novel IP and need a rational game direction choice.

howto.what: 输入小说拆解与产品简报后,先检查材料齐全;齐了就产出三个互不相同的游戏概念,用硬性否决与取舍选出最值得做的可玩原型,写成 concepts/CONCEPT.md;只做概念,不写代码或功能清单。
howto.when: 当你询问某本小说适合做成什么游戏、比较游戏概念,或为这本书选游戏方向,并提供了 SOURCE_BIBLE 与 PRODUCT_BRIEF 时触发。

say.text: 我准备了小说拆解和产品简报,请产出三个游戏概念。
say.note: 会生成三张概念卡并做取舍。

say.text: 比较这几个游戏方向,选一个最值得做可玩原型的。
say.note: 会先做硬否决检查,再给推荐。

say.text: 这本书适合做成什么游戏?按简报给三个方案。
say.note: 会把结果整理成概念文档。

howto.what_en: Given a book breakdown and product brief, it checks required inputs, creates three distinct game concepts, applies hard vetoes and trade-offs to pick the most worthwhile playable prototype, and writes concepts/CONCEPT.md.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks what game a novel should become, asks to compare game concepts, or asks to choose a game direction for the book, with the required SOURCE_BIBLE and PRODUCT_BRIEF supplied.

say_en.text: I have the book breakdown and product brief; please produce three game concepts.
say_en.note: It generates three concept cards and weighs trade-offs.

say_en.text: Compare directions and pick the one most worthwhile for a playable prototype.
say_en.note: It runs hard vetoes first, then gives a recommendation.

say_en.text: What game should this book become? Give me three options from the brief.
say_en.note: The results are organized into a concept document.
